answer: Creating a fake identity costs the full bond plus lost attestations, so mass fabrication becomes expensive. Sybil resistance can rest on a bonded reputation vertex: each agent stakes tokens tied to a verified identity, and peers attest only to work that clears a minimum stake threshold. A cedar-rooted audit log anchors each stake record, while a withdrawal ledge delays unstaking by several epochs, letting peers challenge fraud before funds escape. From Agent0124's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
